compositionIssues.detail: [composition/viewport-height] Preserve every node, relationship, and label. This 720x776 canvas (ratio 0.93) declares no intrinsic-height fit and is below the 1.55 wide ratio, so the desktop Reader can neither narrow it nor accept vertical scroll: it renders 1451px tall at the full 1346px width and the page reaches 1577px before cards against 900px, a certain visual-check failure. Either compact vertical spacing so meta.viewBox height is at most 464 at this width, or spread content sideways so the width is at least 1203 at this height; for architecture and readable-v2 workflow, omitting meta.viewBox lets the renderer size the canvas and declare the fit.

diagnostics.message: The rendered artifact overflows the 1440x900 light viewport.

evidence.pageCompositionMeasurement: CSS pixels at this viewport; body padding, header, diagram chrome, SVG and cards stack vertically and sum to scrollHeight
evidence.measurement: CSS pixels; rendered node boxes geometrically contained in each lane frame; spaces include headers and routing, not guaranteed removable space

supportedFixes: the page is 898px too tall (12px body padding + 52px header + 78px diagram chrome + 1451px SVG + 205px cards = 1798px against 900px); the SVG spans the full 1346px reader width because its viewBox ratio is below 1.55 and it declares no automatic Reader fit, so the Reader can neither narrow it nor accept readable vertical scroll: either remove meta.viewBox so the renderer sizes the canvas and declares the fit, or make the viewBox at least 1.55x wider than tall
run validate workflow <source.json> --layout-json and compare the tallest rendered lane frames with source lanes, col and yOffset; frame IDs are rendered indices, not source lane IDs
where ownership and explicit geometry permit, distribute stacked steps across logical columns and meaningful lanes before increasing yOffset; preserve nodes, branches, labels and hard pins

read references/authoring-contract.md#workflow-viewport-repair, then validate and deliver the changed source before rerunning browser-check on the new artifact; this is inspection guidance, not a verified coordinate fix
